text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: spike in 5xx and timeouts on /v1/embeddings (eu-central-1). Error rate up from ~0.2% to 9% starting ~09:42 UTC. Pager: Priya (SRE). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/embeddings-5xx.
Priya (SRE): Ack, I'm on-call. Quick checks: is this customer-facing? Sam, any tickets or live chats?
Sam (Support): Yep — 5 tickets, 2 P1s reporting truncated embeddings and long hangs. One customer (Nimbus.ai) timed out on a batch job.
Jonas (Eng-Model): Looking at serving metrics: serving-group embeddings-v2 shows pod churn ~09:43, scale-up was slower than expected. Autoscaler logs show last-change at 09:40 with a new headroom target.
Lee (Eng-Platform): Heads up — we deployed autoscaler tuning at 09:39 to reduce spare capacity for cost savings (target headroom 5% -> 2%). That may cause slower scale during bursts.
Priya (SRE): Okay hold. I'm flipping on increased sampling for logs and traces and grabbing logs for 09:35-09:50. Running ad-hoc query now:
```
logs.search("service:embeddings AND status:5xx", from="2026-07-12T09:35:00Z", to="2026-07-12T09:50:00Z")
```
Jonas (Eng-Model): I'm also seeing request paths with large batch sizes (n=1024) around 09:42. Memory pressure looks high on a few pods. Might be a combination of big batches + low headroom.
Priya (SRE): Pasting a small log excerpt (redacted ids):
```
[09:42:11] proxy WARN handler=embed status=504 upstream=pod-99 msg="upstream-hang"
[09:42:12] model ERROR oom: killed memory=6.2G batches=1024 pod=pod-99
[09:42:13] proxy INFO handler=embed status=200 upstream=pod-100 req_id=abcd-...
[09:42:14] proxy INFO handler=embed status=200 upstream=pod-101 req_id=    <-- missing
```
Priya (SRE): Notice some req_id fields are empty. That's odd — we changed log-forwarder sampling briefly in a deploy at 09:38 (should have been 100% but config set to 20%). I'm requesting the archived logs to fill gaps.
Lee (Eng-Platform): Confirmed: a config leak in the k8s ConfigMap for log-forwarder happened during the 09:38 infra rollout; sampling set to 20%. Reverting now.
PagerBot: ACTION: Priya acknowledged the page and initiated mitigation.
Priya (SRE): Immediate mitigations: 1) scaled embeddings-v2 +3 replicas, 2) temporarily reject batches >512 with 429 to protect nodes, 3) adjusted HPA target to previous headroom (5%), 4) enabled full log/tracing sampling. Initiating 1 & 3 now.
Jonas (Eng-Model): After scale, error rate fell to ~1.4% but there are still intermittent timeouts and truncated outputs for long batches. Heap profiles from affected pods show sustained high RSS. I'll try a live debug attach to capture heap profile for pod-99.
Sam (Support): Customer impact: 8 accounts affected, Nimbus.ai job failures for 6 minutes (09:41-09:47). I'm drafting customer messages and will provide an impact timeline.
Priya (SRE): Observability gaps noted for RCA: - log forwarding sampling misconfiguration at 09:38 -> significant log gaps, - dashboard alert threshold change in grafana (alert disabled quietly) causing delayed operator response, - request id propagation was inconsistent across a week-long proxy rollout (we saw missing ids in some lines).
Lee (Eng-Platform): I also discovered that a recent LB idle-timeout change (from 120s -> 30s) was applied to the eu cluster during a network patch at 09:30. That can explain truncated responses for long-running embedding operations. Rolling back the idle-timeout now.
Jonas (Eng-Model): Hypotheses for root cause chain:
- Primary: reduced autoscaler headroom caused delayed scaling under a burst of large batch requests -> memory pressure -> OOMs -> pod restarts -> 5xx.
- Contributing: LB idle timeout applied earlier caused payload truncation for long-running requests.
- Observability: log sampling and dashboard alert accidental changes slowed detection and triage.
Priya (SRE): Tests to run: repro with synthetic large-batch load, verify autoscaler reaction time with headroom 2% vs 5%, check pod memory limiter behavior for batch sizes >512. Jonas, can you run the local repro?
Jonas (Eng-Model): Running a targeted loadtest now (script below):
```
# run on staging with env override
python tools/loadgen.py --endpoint /v1/embeddings --batch-size 1024 --qps 40 --duration 120
```
Priya (SRE): Also requesting archived logs for 09:30-09:50 from log-archiver and any span traces. If archived logs are incomplete due to sampling, ask infra to restore from collector buffer.
Lee (Eng-Platform): I've opened OPS-445 to harden config promotion: ensure sampling default is 100% for critical proxies and add a gate to prevent accidental override. Also rolling back LB idle-timeout now.
Sam (Support): Sending a customer-facing note: "We saw transient timeouts/5xx on embeddings in eu-central-1 between 09:41-09:47. We scaled and mitigated; follow-up RCA to come." Will send in 15m.
Priya (SRE): Handoff plan: I'm going to stabilize and then hand to Lee for config fixes and to Jonas for model-side mitigations. Next on-call: Lee will monitor for 1 hour and continue RCA collection. Handing off at 1823456810.
IncidentBot: ONCALL_HANDOFF: Priya -> Lee at 1823456810.
Lee (Eng-Platform): Ack handoff. I'll collect the archived logs, confirm sampling restoration, and coordinate LB rollback verification. Creating INC-2026-789 ticket for RCA.
Jonas (Eng-Model): Update: loadtest reproduced OOM at scale when batch-size 1024 with headroom 2%. With headroom 5% scale looks safe. Attaching test notes to the incident ticket.
Priya (SRE): Final live-thread notes: mitigations executed (scale +3, HPA reverted, LB timeout rolled back, batch-size throttling), customer comms drafted, blockers for RCA: missing logs due to sampling, inconsistent req_id propagation across proxy rollout. Moving to post-incident RCA doc INC-2026-789-RCA.
Sam (Support): I'll update customers once Lee confirms archived logs availability.
Priya (SRE): Thanks folks. Closing live thread; continuing RCA in INC-2026-789.
